evidence.quote:
Der q-minus-Basis-Unterschied für Prozess/Stoff+Mittelstufe ist `-0.010526`;
der Basis-minus-q-Unterschied für Zubereitung ist `0.021053`. Das ist
praktisch dieselbe Verteilung, nicht die behauptete Gegenüberstellung. Der
gerichtete Test scheitert. Dasselbe gilt für alle fünf frequenzähnlichen
q/Basis- und fünf Nicht-q-Kontrollpaare.

Die beiden alten Sätze werden als gesprochene Ganzwortwerte abgezogen. Der
explorative Arbeitsdefault lautet nun für beide Formen:

> **Wärme-/Mittelstufenfeld; genaue Funktion und Träger offen.**

Das ist bewusst nicht „bedeutungslos“. Der gemeinsame Wärme-/Stufenansatz
bleibt als Arbeitshypothese erhalten, weil er die Formfamilie weiterhin knapp
beschreibt und hier nicht unmöglich wird. Nicht mehr behauptet werden:

The best current `pcheey` reading is now narrower and more useful:

> **bound dry-preparation/Form-II record-content field with a following-value
> affinity; substance identity open**

It is not merely a generic list marker. Two of its three occurrences form the
reader-exact sequence `pcheey X daiin`, and all three lead into a recognizable
working content, quality, or amount neighborhood. At the same time, the right
fields are ordinary enough for H1 record ecology that they do not prove a
named ingredient. The local source reading “from/with dry material, Form II”
survives as a concrete C1 rival. The post-moist residue/result reading becomes
the weakest rival.

The exact local triple appears at:

- `pcheey qoty daiin` on `f10v.1`;
- `pcheey dal daiin` on `f105r.24`.

Thus `pcheey` has two hits in three occurrences. All other H1 forms together
have three hits in 196 occurrences: `pchaiin ofchy daiin`,
`pcheody oteody daiin`, and `pchedal qopchdy daiin`.

A stricter non-H1 control contains eleven surfaces and 33 occurrences: every
surface occurs exactly three times on three pages, always medially and on
paragraph-start lines, and none is quarantined. Only `chopy` has one matching
triple, `chopy chofol daiin`. This does not translate `daiin` as a number or
unit; it supports a repeated value-field relation.

root_decisions.reason: The shared heat/middle-stage hypothesis is explicitly retained by GDT753. Failed q/base differentiation does not make its shared-state hypothesis new. A future invariance test needs a narrowly fixed stage and independent discriminating observations; no new data or test is supplied here.

The following-value/content-field lead and two-of-three pattern are already GDT763 observations. Substance or result heads can select complements; independent accurate role labels do not alone make those categories exclusive. A future method must specify differing predictions, rather than count the same attachment again.

limits: Candidate-history retention and duplicate/method-overlap adjudication only. Existing semantic cards, raw records and old scientific gates are unchanged. No empirical refutation of the semantic hypotheses and no confirmed meaning.
